errors.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
errors.provider: The simulated service did not respond (error mode is on). Turn error mode off and retry.
errors.not_found: We could not find what you were looking for.
errors.no_lockable: There are no consecutive open installments for this term.
errors.cutoff: The deadline to secure that installment has passed (3 business days before it is due).
errors.not_quoted: This quote is no longer available.
errors.quote_expired: The quote expired. Request a new one to see the current rate.
errors.nothing_to_book: There are no pending legs to hedge.
errors.nothing_to_pay_ahead: There is no open quarter to pay ahead.
errors.plan_blocked: This plan is on hold: payments and rate locks are paused for now.
errors.installment_missed: This installment is paid through your advisor, who confirms the amount.
errors.locks_disabled: The installments of this plan are already in dollars: there is no rate to secure.
errors.method_not_offered: This way to pay is not available for your plan.
errors.above_limit: Cash payments are capped at USD 950 per reference. You can pay at the office or from your bank.
errors.below_limit: Cash payments have a minimum of USD 5 per reference.
errors.state_excluded: Cash payment is not available in your state. You can pay at the office or from your bank.
errors.reference_expired: Your reference expired. Request a new one to pay in cash.
errors.reference_not_completed: Your cash payment has not been confirmed yet. Once it is, your installment will be recorded.
errors.not_due_yet: This installment cannot be paid yet. We will let you know when the window opens.
errors.insufficient_cash: The amount received is less than the installment amount.
errors.seller_unverified: Your payment is recorded. Delivery to the seller waits until their verification is complete.
errors.seller_paused: Your payment is recorded. Delivery to the seller is paused while their account is reviewed.
errors.seller_rejected: Your payment is recorded. Delivery to the seller is stopped; your advisor will contact you.
errors.seller_cooling_off: Your payment is recorded. Delivery to the seller waits for a verification of their account.
errors.cnr_alert: Your payment is recorded. Delivery to the seller waits while we review a registry update on the property.
errors.invalid_transition: This action cannot be applied in the current state.
errors.not_implemented: This feature is not available yet.

actions.lockHint: Secure the rate of your next installments
actions.payAheadHint: Pay the next open quarter at today's rate
actions.blocked: Payments and rate locks are paused until the notice above is resolved.

calendar.title: Installment calendar
calendar.subtitle: {count} monthly installments of {cop}
calendar.legendRecibido: Received (delivered to the seller on the due date)

card.title: Installment {n}
card.diffNone: No difference: this installment is not secured
card.graceUntil: Until {date} ({days} business days after the due date)
card.breakHint: The securing broke. This cost is added to the installment payment, which converts at today's rate.
card.missed: This installment was not paid after the grace period. Your advisor will help you catch up.
card.waived: The builder waived this installment: you do not need to pay it.

lock.title: Secure rate
lock.intro: Constructora Bolívar secures the dollar value of your next installments.
lock.chooseTenor: How many installments do you want to secure?
lock.headline: Constructora Bolívar secures your next payments at {usd}
lock.atSpot: At today's rate ({rate}) it would be {usd}
lock.disclosure1: If a secured installment is not paid within the 5 business days of grace, the securing of that installment breaks and the break cost is charged.
lock.disclosure2: The secured price includes a certainty premium: part of the forward points stays with Constructora Bolívar.
lock.disclosure3: The price of VIS housing adjusts to the SMMLV of the deed year and is not secured; only the dollar value of these installments is secured.
lock.acceptHint: Accept the securing from Constructora Bolívar
lock.success: Done: installments M{from}–M{to} are now secured.

pay.title: Pay installment {n}
pay.sourceValue: ACH debit from your U.S. account (simulated)

payAhead.title: Pay ahead
payAhead.explain: Converts the next open quarter (3 installments) at today's rate ({rate}) and delivers it to the trust account. This is not a securing: you pay today's dollar value.
payAhead.doneHint: Each installment was delivered to the trust account with its receipt.

receipt.title: Receipt · Installment {n}
receipt.usdAtToday: At the rate of the day you would have paid
receipt.extra: Difference versus the rate of the day

receipts.title: Payment receipts
receipts.emptyBody: When you pay an installment, its receipt will appear here.

renewal.text: Your current securing ends with installment {n} ({date}). Secure the next quarter (M{from}–M{to}) now.
renewal.textNoPrevious: Constructora Bolívar offers to secure the next quarter (M{from}–M{to}).

late_in_grace.title: Installment {n} is pending
late_in_grace.body: It was due on {due}. You are within the grace period, which ends on {graceEnds}.
late_in_grace.next: You can pay it with the "Pay" button. If you already paid, there is nothing else to do.

missed.title: Installment {n} was not paid
missed.body: It was due on {due} and the grace period is over. Your plan is still in force.
missed.next: Write to your advisor to catch up: they confirm the amount and the date.

on_hold.title: Your plan is on hold
on_hold.next: Payments are paused while the hold lasts. Your advisor will contact you; there is nothing you need to do for now.

defaulted.title: Your plan needs attention
defaulted.body: Several installments were not paid and the builder recorded the plan as in default on {since}.
defaulted.next: Talk to your advisor about the options available for your case.

cancelled.title: Your plan was cancelled
cancelled.held: We hold {usd} in your name. The refund is calculated under your trust agreement (encargo).
cancelled.next: Your advisor will contact you to agree on the refund.

constructora.title: Builder / Trust
constructora.subtitle: Units sold, schedule progress and reconciliation of the payments received in each trust account.

units.title: Units and payment plans
units.empty: This project has no units with a payment plan.
units.scheduleAria: Schedule: {paid} paid, {locked} locked, {broken} broken, {missed} unpaid, {waived} waived and {open} open out of {total} installments
units.dueHint: Installments whose due date is today or earlier
units.noLocksHint: This buyer pays at the daily rate; no installment has a locked rate.

recon.title: Payment reconciliation
recon.caption: Payments received per installment: rate applied, anchor COP, hedge settlement, basis, margin and COP credited to the trust account
recon.footnote: Reconciliation: anchor COP + hedge settlement − basis − margin = COP credited. Rounding differences under COP 50 are reconciled automatically.

titles.paid: Date and time the payment was received
titles.rate: Rate applied: locked or daily rate (spot)
titles.anchor: COP delivered by the anchor when converting the USD
titles.ndf: COP from the hedge (NDF) settlement; blank until it settles
titles.basis: Basis: anchor COP minus USD at the settlement TRM
titles.margin: Margin retained: USD times (forward − locked rate)
titles.credited: COP credited to the trust account

events.hold_frozen: Hold: money held by the issuer

tesoreria.subtitle: Hedge book for the rate locks, curve in use, forward-point pass-through and margin.

book.legAria: Leg for {buyer} due {date}: {usd} at locked rate {rate}, state {state}

titles.banrep: Registration reference with Banco de la República
titles.settled: COP received or paid when the NDF settled
